scope: C0/C1 paired short trials, existing 1288-parameter head, no C2

calibration.aggregation: sqrt(mean(all parent,bank,draw,384 samples of preADC random_shape squared))
calibration.solver: Cache one frozen A decoded output per parent, fixed 16 bisections on initial weight multiplier [0,1], choose final midpoint; no loss or REAL access; fail if scale1 does not bracket target; report residual
calibration.capacity: Only initial head weights are scaled; no persistent multiplier, gain, clipping or later restriction
calibration.paired_reuse: Each seed calibrates once; C0/C1 share the same calibrated initial head bytes

gradient_probe.strata: fixed TRAIN canonical SOURCE Q quartiles plus four predeclared individual parents, all diagnostic only
gradient_probe.requirement: bounded stratum subbatch gradients, raw Q/PSD counts, parent lineage, peak switches vs initial probe; never per-event loss contribution percentages

proposals_for_root_once.evaluation: Reuse WP1 full-population hard evaluator and frozen T table once root gives binding; 2 banks x 6593 parents x4 draws x3 hypotheses at initial and final, final old native QPSD plus all raw/hard metrics

unresolved_for_launch: Root must supply frozen T path and SHA
Root must freeze exact budgets/probe and evaluation scope before scientific access
